rubric.role_summary: Senior research scientist developing benchmarks, evaluation methods, and infrastructure to measure large language model capabilities and performance.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior research scientist developing benchmarks, evaluation methods, and infrastructure to measure large language model capabilities and performance.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Developed resources to measure LLM capabilities.
- Software engineering experience.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Spent dozens of hours reviewing complex data and LLM outputs to ensure high data quality.
- Strong software engineering skills.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Toronto, Canada area; San Francisco Bay Area, California; Greater Seattle area, Washington; Greater London, United Kingdom area; New York metropolitan area; Greater Montreal, Canada area; Greater Paris, France area; Greater Berlin, Germany area; Greater Seoul, South Korea area; Canada; United States. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
